name: Gaussian Splat View of TSDF Band
definition: A visualization technique that renders a filtered Truncated Signed Distance Function (TSDF) voxel band as a continuous surface using isotropic Gaussian splats, where one Gaussian is generated per surface voxel.
summary: Gaussian Splat View of TSDF Band renders filtered voxel data as isotropic splats, offering a differentiable, continuous surface suitable for real-time visualization.
